title: KiaKio and Squared Numbers
statement: Each of n numbers (values up to 10^9) is repeatedly replaced by the sum of the squares of its digits. Two numbers are in tune if their sequences become identical from some step on; the task counts in-tune pairs. One step drops any value to at most 729 and every sequence soon reaches 1 or an 8-cycle, so simulating a fixed number of steps and comparing values handles cycle phase.
